advisories.title: Renderer does not refuse keywords outside the supported profile and can narrow on them
advisories.text: render-types.cjs silently ignores unknown keywords. Small case: {type:'array', prefixItems:[{type:'string'}], items:false} renders `export type A = ((never)[])`, rejecting the valid ["x"]. Current inputs contain no such keywords and output-e has 0 never nodes, and the TS02 runtime refuses such schemas at admission. Before integration, refuse any keyword outside schema.ts known/annotation sets (shared with prepare.py).

advisories.title: AST exactness audit misses numeric literal types
advisories.text: The audit counts only NumberKeyword/AnyKeyword. Small case: enum [{a:1}] renders `"a": 1`, a JS-number literal type. prepare.py adds tsType only when a top-level enum member is an int. Current projection has 0 such nodes (independent scan) and output-e has 0 numeric literal types (independent AST audit; 249 report and 26 provider bigint literal types). Extend the audit to NumericLiteral literal types and nested enum/const values.

advisories.title: Integer collapse widens const/enum carriers
advisories.text: prepare.py returns {type:integer} for every integer node whose explicit or defaulted bounds span negatives and >i64::MAX, including unbounded const/enum nodes such as schemaVersion consts and edition enums (207 ExactInteger projection nodes; const 392->192). This is correct for an inert carrier, but Rust types no longer express closed integer sets; handwritten admission or the original runtime must govern.

advisories.title: Generation side effect outside FRESH_OUTPUT
advisories.text: generate-ts-v2.cjs rewrites ts-exports.json beside the script. The review observed identical rewrites on both fresh runs; registered drift checks should write this inventory under the output root or compare it explicitly.

advisories.title: Two TypeScript versions in the recipe
advisories.text: The renderer prints with TypeScript 6.0.3 (m1-typescript-api-trial-01) while prior compile commands use tsc 7.0.2 (m1-generator-trial-01). Both compile all outputs and assignment corpora here; select and pin one before integration.

advisories.title: Witness checker writes into its origin directory
advisories.text: witness_common.OUT is hardcoded to m1-schema-witnesses-01 and check.py rewrites manifest.json/result.json there. The review ran it in a copy with OUT pointed at the copy (one-line change recorded); results were equal to the frozen files.

advisories.title: Positive evidence remains bounded
advisories.text: Witness strings are minimal (e.g. "a"), one ref (graph-query:3 Params) has only {} and 15 refs have exactly one witness; single-point mutation produced no additional valid value for 263 refs; values of -2^63 were valid only at the FindingParameters and Sarif sites.
